app.name: Crop Guardian
app.tagline: Take a photo of a rice leaf and get the right advice

hero.headline: One leaf photo. A whole area protected.
hero.sub: Take a photo of a rice leaf. Identify the disease. Warn your area in time.
hero.trustLine: Built on public Bangladeshi field datasets · every answer is cited

step1.title: Snap
step1.text: Fill the frame with one leaf.

step2.title: Check
step2.text: We first check it is a rice leaf, then identify the disease.

step3.title: Know when unsure
step3.text: If the AI is not sure, a reviewer looks at the photo.

step5.title: Warn the area
step5.text: When many reports come from one area, an approved alert is sent.

landing.demoNotice: This is a demo. Outbreak data shown here is simulated.

scan.title: Take a leaf photo
scan.cameraDenied: The camera could not be started. Choose a photo from your gallery.

hint.oneLeaf: Fill the frame with one leaf
hint.moreLight: Take the photo again where there is more light
hint.blurry: Hold the phone steady and take the photo again

advice.title: Advice
advice.basedOn: Based on published BRRI/DAE guidance · not yet reviewed by an agronomist
advice.seekHelp: When to visit the agriculture office
advice.chemicalSafety: Read the label and wear protective clothing before using any chemical.
advice.unavailable: Advice cannot be prepared right now. See the general safe steps below.

notSure.title: I am not sure
notSure.body: The disease cannot be told reliably from this photo. We will not guess and give wrong advice.
notSure.sentToReviewer: The photo has been sent to a reviewer.
notSure.tipLight: Take the photo where there is more light.
notSure.tipClose: Take the photo close to a single leaf.

notRice.title: This does not look like a rice leaf
notRice.body: Take the photo again, close to a rice leaf.
